title: Checkpoint
description: A recorded, restorable project state. Spec §11 git safety rules and §6 rollback. This is the ONLY rollback primitive — Unity's Undo stack is explicitly not durable and is never used as one (spec §7 transaction model note).

kind.description: pre_task is the one restored by full rollback; post_transaction/post_repair are intermediate points a repair loop can retarget without discarding the whole task.

gitRef.description: Commit hash on the task branch (attest/task-<id>, spec §11), not a ref name — refs move, hashes don't.

preTaskBranch.description: Set on the pre_task checkpoint only: the user's original branch name, restored on completion (spec §11).

dirtyWorktreeHandling.description: Records which of the two permitted mechanisms (spec §11) preserved the user's uncommitted work, if any existed at task start.

packageManifestState.description: Snapshot of Packages/manifest.json before this checkpoint's mutations, so a Runtime-package-install line can be reverted precisely (spec §7 placement rule 1).

verification.description: Spec §11: 'rollback verification is part of rollback... a rollback that isn't verified didn't happen.'
